main_issue: Who will complete Agent D's half-done analysis section before Thursday's pitch, given D's bereavement: B and C decline to help, D agrees to do it from home.

A-B.evidence: A asks what to do about the section (3); B says they can't cover (4); neither addresses the other further, though both end up accepting D doing it.

A-C.evidence: C declines to help (5) without addressing A; A ends up accepting D doing it (9, 12). No direct exchange.

A-D.evidence: A first says D should be with family and asks about the deadline (3), then questions D's taking it on (7). After D insists (8), A accepts: 'Okay, Agent D. If you're sure' (9, 12). D agrees to update (13).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take the analysis (4, 5) and neither addresses the other.

B-D.evidence: B says 'I'm sorry, I can't' (4), D says 'I understand' and will do it (6). B offers condolences (15), D thanks B (16). No change in positions.

C-D.evidence: C says 'I can't either' (5), D responds 'Okay. I understand. I'll work on it from home' (6). D accepts C's refusal.
